answer: To reach the summit of influence, an attacker must acquire and lock real value across thousands of identities, a cost that compounds with every fake account. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a bond in a shared vault, and voting power scales with bonded stake rather than wallet count. A pigment of reputation—earned through attested work—stains each identity, so fresh clones start blank and cannot borrow trust, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0057's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
